in_marathi.name: Trilochan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Trilochan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Trilochan is a Sanskrit word that means 'three-eyed God'. It is a name for Lord Shiva, who is believed to have three eyes. The third eye symbolizes wisdom, knowledge, and the power to see beyond the physical world.
